caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling a decorative purse or pouch set against a plain, beige background. The purse has a rounded, bulbous body and a metal clasp at the top, which is colored in shades of yellow and light brown, suggesting a metallic appearance. The main body of the pouch is divided into two sections: the upper section features a pattern with red and green elements on a pale or off-white background, possibly representing stylized floral or geometric designs. The lower section displays a diamond or petal-shaped motif created with alternating pink and green shapes. At the bottom tip of the purse, there is a circular, textured knob or tassel colored in a dark greenish-blue with small magenta details. The entire design is comprised of small, dot-like marks, lending a textured and stippled appearance throughout the composition. The object is centrally placed, and there are no other items or decorative elements present on the background.
title: Purse
